newsitem.title: UK: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.
newsitem.headline: U.K. Intervention Board details EU sugar sales.

text.p: A total 93,500 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 43.392 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
Out of this, traders in France received 42,500 tonnes, in Germany 22,000, in Denmark 12,000, in Belgium 7,000, in the Netherlands 6,000 and in the U.K. 4,000 tonnes, it added.
Earlier on Wednesday, London traders had expected the subsidy for the current season whites campaign for licences to be 43.392 Ecus per 100 kilos -- the exact amount awarded.
Traders had also forecast the total authorised sugar tonnage export awards to be at least 60,000 tonnes versus just 250 last week when the restitution was 43.106 Ecus.
